start.text:
You arrive at Oakhaven as dawn breaks over the thatched rooftops. The village square is quiet — too quiet for a market day. A weathered notice board near the well bears a freshly pinned parchment: 'MISSING — Young Lord Aldric Ashford. Last seen three nights past. Reward: 150 Gold Pieces.'

The Mayor's estate looms on the hill, its windows dark. A plume of smoke rises from the tavern chimney, and muddy tracks lead toward the eastern forest.

choices.text: Head to the Rusty Flagon tavern to gather rumors
Go directly to the Mayor's estate to investigate
Follow the muddy tracks into the forest
Examine the notice board for more clues

tavern.text:
The Rusty Flagon smells of woodsmoke and stale ale. A few haggard villagers nurse their drinks. The barkeep, a stout woman named Marta, eyes you suspiciously.

'Another adventurer sniffing around for the reward, eh? I'll tell you what I told the last one — young Aldric was seen arguing with a hooded stranger the night he vanished. They were near the old mill.'

A drunk farmer in the corner mumbles something about 'lights in the forest' before passing out.

choices.text: Ask Marta about the hooded stranger
Try to wake the drunk farmer for more details
Head to the old mill Marta mentioned
Leave and investigate the Mayor's estate

estate.text:
The Ashford estate is imposing but neglected. Ivy crawls up crumbling stone walls. A servant answers the door — pale, nervous.

'The Mayor is... indisposed. He hasn't slept since Lord Aldric disappeared.' She glances over her shoulder. 'But I found something in Aldric's room. A torn letter. I didn't show the guard — they don't care about us smallfolk.'

She presses a scrap of parchment into your hand. It reads: '...meet me at moonrise. The ritual requires willing blood. Tell no one, or your father pays the price.'

choices.text: Search Aldric's room for more evidence
Demand to see the Mayor immediately
Take the letter to the tavern to ask about rituals
Head to the old mill — the ritual site

notice_board.text:
You study the notice board carefully. Behind the missing poster, you find an older notice partially hidden: 'HERBALIST WANTED — Strange blight affecting crops near the Old Mill. Good pay.'

Scratched into the wood of the board itself, barely visible, are arcane symbols. Someone has been marking this village.

choices.text: Try to identify the arcane symbols
Head to the tavern for information
Investigate the old mill mentioned in the notice
Visit the Mayor's estate
Continue deeper

forest_success.text:
Your keen eyes pick out tracks in the mud — two sets. One stumbling, dragged. The other confident, deliberate. They lead to a clearing where a stone circle stands, ancient and moss-covered.

In the center, you find a torn piece of fine cloth — Aldric's sigil embroidered in silver thread. Dark stains that might be blood mark the altar stone. The tracks continue north toward the old mill.

choices.text: Follow the tracks to the old mill
Examine the stone circle more closely
Return to the village with this evidence

forest_fail.text:
The forest is dense and the tracks are confusing. You wander for an hour before the trail goes cold at a stream crossing. You find nothing of use and return to the village, having wasted precious time.

As you emerge from the treeline, you notice smoke rising from the direction of the old mill.

choices.text: Rush to the old mill
Go to the tavern first for information
Visit the Mayor's estate

hooded_stranger.text:
Marta leans in close. 'The stranger... I've seen their type before. Cult folk. They wear those hooded robes and speak in whispers. This one had a ring — silver serpent eating its own tail. Symbol of the Ouroboros Circle.'

She shudders. 'They practice dark magic. Blood rituals. If they have young Aldric...' She trails off. 'The old mill. That's where they gather when the moon is right. And tonight...' She glances at the darkening sky. 'Tonight is a full moon.'

choices.text: Rush to the old mill immediately — no time to waste!
Prepare first — ask if she has any supplies
Head to the estate to warn the Mayor
Continue

farmer_success.text:
You shake the farmer awake and buy him an ale. His eyes focus slightly. 'The lights... green lights, floating near the old mill every full moon. I saw 'em last month. And singing — dark chanting. My sheep won't go near that place anymore.'

He grabs your arm. 'Don't go there alone, adventurer. Three men went to investigate last season. Only one came back, and he doesn't speak anymore.'

choices.text: Head to the old mill despite the warning
Ask Marta about the hooded stranger
Prepare supplies before heading out

farmer_fail.text: The farmer swats your hand away and mutters incoherently before slumping back to sleep. His last coherent word is '...mill...' before he starts snoring loudly.

choices.text: Ask Marta about the hooded stranger instead
Leave and investigate the old mill
Head to the Mayor's estate

old_mill.text:
The old mill stands at the edge of town, its waterwheel long broken. The building leans at an unsettling angle and the air around it feels... wrong. Heavy. Like before a storm.

As you approach, you smell incense and something metallic — blood. Light flickers through gaps in the boarded windows.

choices.text: Burst through the front door
Sneak around back and look for another way in
Peer through the gaps in the boards first

mill_peek.text:
Through the gaps you see a horrifying scene: a ritual circle drawn in blood on the floor. Three hooded figures chant around an altar where a young man — Aldric — lies bound but alive. A dark crystal pulses with green light above him.

One figure raises a curved dagger. You have seconds to act.

choices.text: Smash through the window to stop them!
Try to sneak in from behind

tavern_supplies.text:
Marta rummages behind the counter and produces a small vial. 'Holy water — kept it since the last priest passed through. Take it. If those cultists are channeling dark magic, this might disrupt their ritual.'

She also hands you a sturdy iron poker from the fireplace. 'Better than nothing.'

choices.text: Thank her and head to the old mill
Ask for directions to the mill's back entrance

meet_mayor.text:
The Mayor is a broken man — gaunt, unshaven, pacing his study. 'My boy... my only son. The guard captain says he probably ran away, but I know better. Aldric wouldn't leave willingly.'

He shows you a note he received: 'Your bloodline carries the old power. The boy will serve a greater purpose. Do not interfere.'

'Please,' he begs. 'Save my son. I'll give you everything I have.'

choices.text: Show him the torn letter from Aldric's room
Promise to save Aldric and head to the old mill
Ask about the 'old power' in his bloodline

ritual_info.text:
Piecing together the evidence, you realize: the Ouroboros Circle is attempting a blood ritual using Aldric's noble bloodline to summon something from beyond. The ritual must be completed during the full moon — which is tonight!

The old mill is their gathering place. You must stop them before midnight.

choices.text: Race to the old mill immediately!
Get holy water from the tavern first

symbols_success.text:
You recognize the symbols — they're warding glyphs used by the Ouroboros Circle, a banned cult that practices blood magic. These marks are territorial. They've claimed this village as their domain.

The symbols point toward the old mill as a convergence point.

choices.text: Head to the old mill at once
Gather more intel at the tavern
Warn the Mayor at his estate

symbols_fail.text: The symbols are unfamiliar to you — some kind of arcane marking, but you can't determine their meaning. Perhaps someone in town would know more.

choices.text: Ask at the tavern
Visit the Mayor's estate
Continue

room_success.text:
In Aldric's room, you find a hidden journal beneath a loose floorboard. The last entries are disturbing: 'The stranger says my blood can change everything. That I have power I never knew about. He says the ritual is painless. I want to believe him, but something feels wrong...'

The final entry: 'Meeting tonight at the old mill. If I don't come back, forgive me, Father.'

choices.text: Rush to the old mill
Show this to the Mayor
Ask the tavern keeper about the ritual

room_fail.text: You search the room but find little of note — some personal effects, books on heraldry, nothing obviously connected to the disappearance. The servant watches nervously from the doorway.

choices.text: Ask to see the Mayor
Head to the tavern for clues
Investigate the old mill

mill_entrance.text:
You burst into the mill! Three cultists in dark robes spin to face you, their chanting interrupted. The leader — tall, with a silver serpent ring — holds a curved dagger above Aldric, who is bound to the blood-soaked altar.

The dark crystal above pulses violently with green energy. The air crackles.

'You're too late, fool!' the leader snarls. 'The ritual is nearly complete!'

choices.text: Attack the cult leader directly!
Destroy the dark crystal to break the ritual
Try to free Aldric from the altar
Use words to stall and intimidate the cultists

mill_sneak.text: You attempt to sneak around back...

choices.text: Continue

mill_sneak_success.text:
You find a cellar entrance hidden behind rotting crates. It leads into the basement beneath the ritual chamber. Through the floorboards above, you can see the scene — three cultists, Aldric on the altar, a pulsing dark crystal.

You can strike from below, targeting either the crystal's support beam or the cult leader's position.

choices.text: Smash the support beam to collapse the crystal
Burst up through the floor behind the leader
Free Aldric through the floor gap

mill_sneak_fail.text:
You step on a brittle plank that snaps with a loud crack. One of the cultists spots you.

'Intruder!' he screams. They've been alerted, and you've lost the element of surprise.

choices.text: Fight your way in!
Continue

fight_win.text:
Your strike lands true! The cult leader staggers back, the dagger clattering from his hand. The other cultists falter as their leader falls.

The dark crystal's light flickers and dies without the ritual chanting. Aldric gasps on the altar as the dark energy releases him.

The remaining cultists flee into the night. You've won.

choices.text: Free Aldric and return him to his father

fight_struggle.text:
The cult leader is more skilled than you expected. He deflects your blow and counter-attacks, his dagger slicing your arm. Pain flares through you.

But the interruption is enough — Aldric thrashes on the altar and kicks the crystal, which shatters on the stone floor! The ritual energy explodes outward, knocking everyone down.

choices.text: Get up and subdue the stunned cultists

crystal_success.text:
Your attack shatters the dark crystal into a thousand pieces! A shockwave of green energy blasts outward, knocking the cultists off their feet. The ritual symbols on the floor crack and fade.

The cult leader screams in rage. 'No! Months of preparation — ruined!' He and his followers flee into the darkness, their power broken.

choices.text: Free Aldric and bring him home

crystal_fail.text:
Your strike misses the crystal and hits the stone altar instead, sending sparks flying. A cultist tackles you from behind.

You struggle on the ground, but Aldric — seeing his chance — kicks the crystal with his bound legs. It cracks and the ritual energy collapses! The cultists flee in panic.

choices.text: Free Aldric from his bindings
Continue

free_success.text:
You cut Aldric's bindings with a swift stroke. He scrambles off the altar, disrupting the ritual circle. The dark crystal loses its anchor and cracks down the middle, its energy dissipating.

'Behind you!' Aldric shouts. You spin to face the cult leader, but without the ritual's power, his dagger has no dark enchantment. He's just a man — and he knows it. The cultists scatter.

choices.text: Escort Aldric home to his father

free_fail.text:
A cultist intercepts you before you reach the altar, slamming into you. You hit the ground hard. The cult leader raises the dagger...

But Aldric isn't helpless. With a surge of desperate strength, he breaks one hand free and grabs the cult leader's wrist. The dagger falls. You seize the moment.

choices.text: Grab the falling dagger and end this

intimidate.text: You try to intimidate the cultists...

choices.text: Continue

intimidate_success.text:
'The Oakhaven Guard is on their way!' you thunder, your voice echoing in the mill. 'Drop the dagger or face the king's justice — and the hangman's rope!'

The two lesser cultists exchange panicked glances and bolt for the exits. The leader, now alone, seethes with impotent rage. He hurls the dagger at you, but it goes wide, shattering the dark crystal instead. How ironic.

'This isn't over,' he hisses, and vanishes through a hidden trapdoor.

choices.text: Free Aldric and return to the village

intimidate_fail.text:
The cult leader laughs. 'The guard? Those fools couldn't find a goblin in a privy. You're alone, and you're too late.'

He brings the dagger down — but Aldric rolls at the last second. The blade strikes the altar stone, shattering the inscribed ritual circle. The dark crystal cracks. The magical backlash throws the leader against the wall.

choices.text: Seize the moment — subdue the stunned cultists

victory.text:
Dawn breaks over Oakhaven as you lead young Aldric through the village gates. The Mayor rushes from his estate — still in his nightclothes — and embraces his son with tears streaming down his face.

'You've saved my boy. You've saved my family.' He presses a heavy purse of gold into your hands. 'You are a hero of Oakhaven. This village will never forget what you've done.'

Aldric turns to you. 'Thank you. I was a fool to trust that stranger. But I learned something...' He holds up his palm, where a faint golden light briefly flickers. 'The old power in my blood — it's real. But next time, I'll use it for good.'

The villagers cheer as the sun rises. Your first adventure is complete.
